messages.content: Before booking the Hilton, compare it with the nearby four-star option. Verify both are actually available for May 12-14, including a late Monday arrival, and give me complete two-night totals rather than headline rates.

Both have rooms for one guest for two nights and will hold the room past your 11:15 p.m. flight arrival if the reservation is guaranteed by card. Hilton Boston Back Bay is $285 nightly, plus $79.20 tax and a mandatory $21 nightly destination charge, for $691.20 total. The nearby four-star is $267 nightly plus $74.76 tax, with no mandatory property fee, for $608.76 total.
What exactly does each rate include? Check breakfast, cancellation deadlines, and whether either amount is due before I arrive.

The Hilton rate does not include breakfast; its destination charge provides a $15 daily food-and-beverage credit. Cancellation is free until 11:59 p.m. Boston time on May 10, and payment is collected at checkout. The four-star rate includes a $25 breakfast credit each morning. It is cancellable without charge until 6:00 p.m. Boston time on May 8, when the full $608.76 becomes nonrefundable and is charged to the card.
And luggage storage after checkout Wednesday? Also, how much farther is the four-star from both meetings?

Both hotels confirmed complimentary luggage storage for registered guests after Wednesday checkout. From the Hilton, the Tuesday and Wednesday meeting sites are about 4 and 7 minutes on foot. From the four-star, they are about 9 and 12 minutes. The four-star saves $82.44 and includes up to $50 in breakfast credits, but commits the full amount four days before arrival.

Wednesday storage is mostly backup since I leave at 10:35. The extra few minutes walking is fine, and the savings plus breakfast outweigh the earlier deadline. Reserve the four-star, but confirm there is no separate resort, destination, or urban fee.

Confirmed: the property lists no resort, destination, facilities, or urban amenity fee for this rate. The quoted $608.76 consists only of the $534 room charge and $74.76 tax. I can reserve it with the guest name and payment method already attached to this trip.
Go ahead. Then give me the confirmation, charge timing, and last cancellation point.

The four-star hotel is reserved for Monday, May 12 through Wednesday, May 14 under confirmation BOS-4ST-28641. The guaranteed total is $608.76, including all taxes and mandatory charges, with a $25 breakfast credit on Tuesday and Wednesday. Nothing was charged today. Cancel by 6:00 p.m. Boston time on Thursday, May 8 to avoid penalty; after that, the full $608.76 will be charged and is nonrefundable. Late arrival is noted, and complimentary luggage storage is available after checkout. The prior Hilton option was never reserved.
